review_type: scoping evidence map, not exhaustive PRISMA systematic review
question: For observed empty-shell plus exact text furniture inventory and unknown dimensions feeding RoomGenBench, what room-generation methods/evaluations/code exist in 2024–2026 and what remains testable?
time_window: 2024-01-01 through2026-10-26; earlier foundations and 2023 preprints with2024 venues separately retained
sources: Official GitHub REST pinned commits and recursive trees
CGF2026 author survey paper and159-row candidate table
citation_chaining: Author CGF2026 survey ->68 rows marked2024/2025 used as candidate seed
Recent method references and author projects ->2026 works
inclusion: Text/floor/scenegraph-conditioned compositional indoor layout or room generation, numerical placement/repair, functional priors, downstream assets and relevant evaluation. Retain close image/procedural/joint-floorplan/industrial neighbors as separately labeled profiles.
exclusion_or_separation: Pure image/video synthesis, single-image scene reconstruction, outdoor-only and generic 2D design not direct main baselines
Foundation ATISS/LayoutGPT and benchmark RoomGenBench explicitly separate from2024–2026 methods
Author seed titles not individually checked are candidates only, not counted as source-verified review entries
reading_levels: Actual metric implementation inspected; method/experiment sections plus repo status; weaker abstract/README records explicitly labeled. Isolated CPU functions are not full-paper reproduction.
code_policy: Repository presence, actual implementation, published weights, benchmark scripts and paper result reproduction are independent fields. Absence limited to sources/commit searched.
deduplication: arXiv base identifiers and normalized titles; preserve different SceneCraft papers and2025/2026 tree-search versions
limits: Not every related paper on earth is guaranteed found.
No model training, asset generation, full-dataset inference or paid VLM runs.
Third-party AI summaries used only for discovery; claims rely on primary papers/author code.
parallel-cli was unavailable. Used available web tool plus direct primary source fetch; did not install/authenticate/pay for extra research service.
No paper ranking from incomparable published metrics; user screenshot raw file unavailable and user requested leaving it aside.
